text:

Applications are invited for the position of one (01) Guest Faculty in Physical Education at
Panjab University Rural Centre, Kauni (Sri Muktsar Sahib) for the odd semester (Academic
Session 2025-2026). Duly filled in hard copy of the application form, along with other self
attested requisite documents, should reach the office of Panjab University Rural Centre,
Kauni(Sri Muktsar Sahib) by 23-09-2025.
EducationalQualification: As per UGC/Panjab University Guidelines
Important Instructions: The applicants are required to fill the application form (Hardcopy
only)available at Panjab University website. (Only one Copy)
Application form is available at
Advertisement Notice of Guest Faculty
directrecruitmentassistantprofessorapplicationformasperugcregulation2018.pdf?13220343242
Affidavit:
Ref. No. UR4K |AKASIJ37aD
Honorarium: The above assignment will be on lecture basis with a token honorarium of Rs.
1500/- per lecture with an upper limit of Rs.50,000/- per month as per Panjab University
norms. The candidate shall have to give an undertaking that he/she will not draw any
fellowship/stipend or any financialassistance from any agency tillthey are in the department
as guest faculty. You are advised to visit the notice board of website
https:/purckauni.puchd.ac, in/show-noticeboard.php?nbid=1 for further updates.
Note:
Temporary/guest/part-time faculty should submit an affidavit to effect that:
https://forms.puchd.ac.in/forms/20200122155429
1. They are not employed elsewhere (guest and part-time faculty are exempted from this
clause).
Sd/
2. There are no criminal proceeding, charges sheets, police cases, cases of moral misconduct
or court cases against them.
1. All shortlisted candidates called for the interview shall be intimated by e-mail/phone. No
separate interview letter shall be sent.
2. All the applicants must also bring their original certificates/testimonials and other relevant
documents for verification at the time of interview.
3. No TA/DAshall be paid for attending the interview.
DIRECTOR
PURC, Kauni. Sri Muktsar Sahib
